_comment: Mount Hermon corrections. IDS ARE FROM THE CURRENT `npm run data` BUILD; `data:refresh` renumbers nodes and will break these. (1) DEM-flat cable-car 2 (רכבל 2) stations both sampled at 1689 m; real bottom 1640 / top 1720. (2) The confluence where black #2 / red #3 / blue #6 meet (n40/n54/n66/n55/n1/n51) was over-sampled at 1736-1745 m — above the lift-2 top — which reversed blue #6; real junction is ~1710 m, so blue #6 now descends from the lift-2 top into it. (3) The central T-bar top (n24) skis out only via 4A in OSM but really also drops onto red Piste 12 at its nearest point (n5) — add that skiable connector. (4) רכבל מבקרים is a foot-passenger sightseeing gondola, not a ski lift — remove it from routing (the summit is still served by רכבל חדש / רכבל 7 / שיאון). (5) Piste 3A's long upper segment (n15→n23, ~720 m) was DEM-sampled with only a 3 m endpoint drop (noisy 1896-1998 m samples) so it became a dashed 2-way flat link; it is really a mellow descent. Raise its top n15 to ~1990 m so it re-derives as a one-way ~49 m descent. (6) Follow-up from the DEM cross-check (`npm run check:elevation`) + map verification: the same confluence was still off. n51 is really its local high point (~1714 m) and n53 was over-sampled by ~41 m (really ~1695 m) - the arrows ran uphill into n51 from both n55 and n53. n54 sits level with n51 (the flat shoulder between them is skied both ways), so it is raised to 1712 m to fall inside pisteFlatTolerance and re-derive as a two-way traverse; n40/n66 then have to rise with it to keep feeding downhill into n54, which the DEM agrees with (it reads them at 1720 m). They are capped at 1716 m rather than the DEM's 1720 m so blue #6 keeps a clean one-way descent from the cable-car 2 top at 1720 m instead of going flat. Net field: n19 1720 -> n40/n66 1716 -> n54 1712 <-> n51 1714 -> n55 1706 -> n1 1703. n53 still drains to n13/n59 and nothing is stranded.
